payload.selection_rationale:
There was one proposal (practice), and it is taken as the core. It fits how the code is already built:
- Every proof case is a function in tests/window/WindowCases.ps1, beside W-001, N-005 and N-006.
- It reuses the hooked launch, the rows dump, CheckPanelAgrees, the stall rig, the CfProvider rig and Write-W001Record.
- It changes no product code and no hook code.

The only fork the last attempt left open was measured by the risk spike, and the answer was go. On 3 of 3 stopped runs, stop mode with FSA_HOOK_AT_FOLDERS plus FSA_HOOK_ROWS=1 ended Cancelled with sized '-' and gave a full rows dump. Row lines, the closing count, the header and core.unreadable all agreed. The 'acted ... ms' and 'rows read ... ms' values came from one clock. So -Stopped and W-003's timing need no hook change, and the design keeps its shape.

The practice designer raised over_engineering_flag against its own design. I took that as a real signal and trimmed further:
- Get-W001Verdict keeps its signature. The new oracle class is counted with the leaks, the same way leaks are already handled.
- The coverage figures are copied by one walk that drops strings, not by a hand-kept field list.

Reading the tree also forced three seam changes, recorded in coherence_check:
1. The engine has already appended this slice's three fitness rules (.taad/fitness.yaml:1495-1524). The SL-107 rule is therefore deleted, not renamed.
2. The moved guard keeps the five plant rows that prove it fires under Fitness's own reading, re-planted at docs/proof-runs.
3. W-003's rig judgement follows N-005's real rule for t and u, instead of a fixed count of 2 rows.

Everything here is cheap to reverse: test harness code, one tests/bugs script, fitness.yaml and plants.json. The irreversible part is the maintainer's own whole-C:\ run (kernel pool possibly held until a restart). It stays theirs, and is already filed as checked_by person.

components.name: W-001 whole-drive proof (finished run)
components.key_interactions: Invoke-HookedRun 'rows' with FSA_HOOK_ROWS=1, Read-RowsDump, CheckPanelAgrees, Get-OracleRow, Get-CheckerControls (its folders stay in the case folder, outside the scanned root), Get-W001Verdict, Get-RecordByCode, Get-CountsOnly and Write-W001Record.

components.name: W-001 -Stopped (stopped-run comparison)
components.key_interactions: Uses the hook's progress trigger (StartupHook.cs:739) and RowsMode, both unchanged. Read-ActedLine, Compare-StoppedRows and Get-StoppedVerdict are pure, so W001ProofTests loads them from the script's parse.

components.name: C4 evidence: the 'refused-another-code' oracle class and the reason/code invariant
components.responsibility:
Get-OracleRow gains the class 'refused-another-code': a code-5 NothingListed row whose plain-mask probe now fails with an error other than 0, 2, 3 or 5. HeldFolderReasonTests shows that a denial answers 5 ahead of a sharing violation. So a folder that still denies the plain open answers 5, and any other refusal means the plain open got past the ACL. That is the signature of a code recorded from the wrong call.

Test-W001 adds this class to the 'opened' tally. Its count gets its own Check and is passed to Get-W001Verdict inside the leak argument, the same way leaks are handled at WindowCases.ps1:6326 and 6334. Get-W001Verdict's signature does not change.

Get-ReasonCodeMismatches counts two kinds of row:
- a row whose reason differs from that of the first row with the same code;
- a row whose reason ends '(Windows error N)' with N other than its own code.
It copies no wording table. This is a consistency check only; the oracle class above is the check that can see a code taken from the wrong call.
components.key_interactions: W001OracleCorpus.json gains a row: NothingListed, code 5, plant 'held', expect 'refused-another-code'. W001OracleTests gains the 'held' plant, a listable folder held through TestNative.HoldFolderSharingNoRead until the oracle has run.

components.name: Counts-only record helpers
components.responsibility:
Write-W001Record keeps its name and its strict throw. Its allowed set gains these fixed labels: completed, cancelled, root-unreadable, refused, local-letter, network-letter, rig, sync-root, home, tailscale, stall, wifi-off, tunnel-down and server-asleep.

Get-RecordByCode builds byCode as code and count, with the reason only when the reason holds no '/' or '\'; otherwise the reason is null. The 995 reason ('The I/O operation ...') holds a slash, and it is exactly the row -Stopped and W-003 exist to record, so it must never make the writer throw after an hour-long run.

Get-CountsOnly copies numbers, booleans and nulls and drops every string.

Get-ProofRecordPath and Get-W001RootShape are pure.

The point is that every caller passes the writer only what it accepts. A throw from the writer is then a writer bug, never a run outcome.
components.key_interactions: Covered by the record fitness rule and by tests/bugs/SL-107-RecordPathRule.Tests.ps1, which checks that the writer and the rule agree on every corpus row.

components.name: W-002 OneDrive no-hydration proof
components.responsibility:
Rig mode (-IncludeCloud, no -Root):
- Clear-StaleCloudRoots, then a fresh root under Get-CloudCaseBase, served by Start-CfProvider 'tree'; wait for READY.
- List the root with the Seam reader.
- Run the app in plain report mode through Start-App and Format-AppArgument (no hook, app pid kept, 120 s wait).
- List the root again.
- dataFetches = the provider's 'CB FETCH_DATA pid=<app pid>' lines.
- Teardown: Remove-CloudRoot. A root still registered, or a folder left behind, fails the case.

Real mode (-Root <sync root>, the maintainer's run): the same listing, scan and listing, with dataFetches null. The prompt asks for an idle OneDrive.

Get-HydrationTally gives:
- onlineOnlyBefore and onlineOnlyAfter;
- hydrated: files online-only before, present after, and no longer online-only;
- goneSinceBefore.
Verdicts: failed when hydrated or dataFetches is above 0; inconclusive when onlineOnlyBefore is 0.

Records go to docs/proof-runs/w002-rig.json or w002-onedrive.json. Exactly one key matches online.?only.*before, one matches online.?only.*after, and 'hydrated' is the only key that contains 'hydrat'.
components.key_interactions: The N-006 cloud helpers, CfProvider's 'tree' scenario, the Seam reader and Write-W001Record.

components.name: Listing-only online-only reader (Seam)
components.responsibility:
One more static method in Initialize-SeamWin32's Add-Type source. It returns path -> attributes for every file under a root, using FindFirstFileExW (FindExInfoBasic, FIND_FIRST_EX_LARGE_FETCH) on \\?\ paths.
- It never opens a file.
- It descends into plain directories and into directories whose reparse tag is a cloud tag ((tag & 0xFFFF0FFF) == 0x9000001A), and into no other reparse point.
Online-only means FILE_ATTRIBUTE_RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS (0x400000), as in CloudPlaceholderTests. Paths stay in memory only.
components.key_interactions: Used by W-002 only. Get-HydrationTally is pure and takes the two maps.

components.name: W-003 share Stop-timing proof
components.responsibility:
Rig mode (-IncludeNetwork, no -Root):
- One stop run through Invoke-SmbSeamRun $case $true (armed stop 2000 ms after s's hold, rig killed 8 s after it).
- stopToEndingMs = the 'rows read ... ms' value minus the acted line's ms. It must be above 0; both come from StartupHook.Clock (spike).
- CheckPanelAgrees with no fixed count, then CheckSeamRow for a ('NothingListed', 5) and b ('ListedPartway', 59).
- cutFolderRows = rows for s, plus rows with code 995, plus rows for t or u whose first rig open came after the closing line's stopUtc. That is N-005's rule. t and u may legitimately be listed before the Stop, so no fixed count of 2 rows is required.
- No 127.0.0.1 mapping may be left.
- Inconclusive when the rig never served, or the hold, a's refusal or b's failure came after the Stop.

Real mode (-Root <share> -Network home|tailscale -Link wifi-off|tunnel-down|server-asleep), the maintainer's run:
- Armed stop with a case-owned marker, FSA_HOOK_CANCEL_DELAY_MS=2000 and FSA_HOOK_ROWS=1.
- The person makes the cut and types 'cut', which writes the marker. This must happen within the hook's fixed 60 s MarkerDeadline from app start.
- Wait-App 600 s.
- A scan that ended before Stop, a refused marker, or any answer other than 'cut' is inconclusive.
- cutFolderRows = rows with code 995.

The record is written in a finally, whatever the ending: network, link, status, outcome, stopToEndingMs, rows, byCode, cutFolderRows and verdict. Files go to docs/proof-runs/w003-rig.json or w003-<network>-<link>.json. No pass bar for the time is invented.
components.key_interactions: Uses the stall rig, the hook's armed stop mode (unchanged), RowsMode, Read-ActedLine and Write-W001Record.

components.name: Case wiring
components.responsibility:
Parameters and case lists:
- The -Case ValidateSet gains W-002 and W-003.
- -Root is accepted for W-001, W-002 and W-003.
- -Stopped and -Force are switches for W-001 only.
- -Network and -Link are ValidateSets for W-003 only.
- W-002 joins $CloudCases. W-003 joins $NetworkCases and $HookedCases.
- A new $ProofCases = 'W-001','W-002','W-003' is filtered out of -Case All. 'All -IncludeCloud' or 'All -IncludeNetwork' therefore never writes under docs/proof-runs.

Line 134's throw becomes '-Root is for W-001, W-002 and W-003 only'.

The file must hold no line containing 'taad', for Q-010's git grep. Rewritten comments must say 'docs/proof-runs' and never name the old location.
components.key_interactions: W001ProofTests reads the script's parse to pin the All filter and the ValidateSet labels.

components.name: Fitness rules and plant rows over the proof-run records
components.key_interactions: eng/rules-harness/harness.py's load_awaiting and Planting (a new-file row plants over an awaited file). All three rules sit below the first '# settled by' marker, so none has an xUnit twin.

components.name: Guard corpus runner (rewritten)
components.responsibility:
Changes to the script:
- $RuleName becomes the new rule's name.
- $RecordRel becomes 'docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json'.
- The files check expects 'docs/proof-runs/*.json'.
- Line 87 checks that WindowCases.ps1 contains 'docs\proof-runs' and does not contain '.taad\slices'.
- The live pass applies the rule to every docs/proof-runs/*.json and to artifacts/w001-run.json.
- The header names the replacement plant rows.
In SL-107-RecordPathRuleCorpus.json, the 'rule' field gets the new name.
components.key_interactions: Reads .taad/fitness.yaml and Write-W001Record from WindowCases.ps1's parse.

components.name: Retired scripts
components.responsibility:
Delete:
- O-030-ledger-discharge.Tests.ps1
- SL-062-LedgerCases.ps1
- SL-068-DecisionCases.ps1
- SL-107-HarnessPlantsOverRecord.Tests.py
- SL-107-HandOffCases.ps1
Each reads .taad/slices. HandOff C-004 also scans the whole D:\ unattended, and would now leave a record under docs/proof-runs. None is in the default suite, and none is an AppArgumentCorpus producer.
components.key_interactions: None is in the default suite, and no producer row in AppArgumentCorpus.json names any of them.

components.name: W001ProofTests and the oracle corpus row
components.key_interactions: Runs in the default suite with no new trait, so the FsaDefaultTestFilter contract is untouched.

contracts.name: WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-001 [-Root <drive|folder>] [-Stopped] [-Force]
contracts.auth_model: Runs as an ordinary, non-elevated account. -Root C:\ (finished, and with -Stopped) is the maintainer's run only: a cold scan of C: has measured about 537 MB of kernel pool, which may be held until a restart (lesson #474). The loop runs W-001 only on SUBST letters over %TEMP% trees (E003-1 to E003-3).
contracts.notes: One command makes the whole PS-033 proof: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-001 -Root C:\ -Stopped, giving docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json. W-001 is never in -Case All.

contracts.name: WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-002 -IncludeCloud [-Root <sync root>]
contracts.auth_model: Rig mode registers and removes a TAAD-made sync root under Get-CloudCaseBase. -Root on the maintainer's OneDrive is their run, because a hydration would change OneDrive's copy of their own files.
contracts.notes: The record goes to docs/proof-runs/w002-rig.json or w002-onedrive.json. Its keys include onlineOnlyBefore, onlineOnlyAfter, hydrated, goneSinceBefore, dataFetches, status, outcome, source and verdict. No other key matches online.?only.*before, online.?only.*after or hydrat (E003-4 counts them).

contracts.name: WindowCases.ps1 -Case W-003 -IncludeNetwork [-Root <share> -Network home|tailscale -Link wifi-off|tunnel-down|server-asleep]
contracts.auth_model: Rig mode makes and removes its own non-persistent loopback mapping. Real mode is the maintainer's: they make the cut and type 'cut'. Cutting Wi-Fi, taking Tailscale down and putting the server to sleep are physical or other-machine acts.
contracts.notes: stopToEndingMs runs from Stop pressed to the stopped ending on screen, on one in-process Stopwatch. Lesson #887: on a day the share's server is down, the exe can stay alive and locked for minutes after its window closes. That is not a regression.

contracts.name: Proof-run record docs/proof-runs/<case>-<source>.json
contracts.auth_model: Written only through Write-W001Record. It holds integers, booleans, nulls, the 40-hex commit, labels from the allowed set, and panel reasons free of separators.
contracts.error_cases: Any other string makes the writer throw and write nothing. Callers rule that out ahead of the write: Get-RecordByCode nulls reasons that hold a separator, Get-CountsOnly drops strings, and a Fact pins the labels.

contracts.name: Fitness rules over the records, plants.json and WindowCases.ps1
contracts.auth_model: Read by the engine's Fitness at every gate, and by eng/rules-harness.
contracts.error_cases: With no docs/proof-runs/*.json committed, the record rule matches no file. The harness accepts that only through awaiting_file pointing at docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json.
contracts.notes: These are the three SL-003 entries already in .taad/fitness.yaml:1495-1524 (see architecture_rules). E003-1's acceptance is Q-010's git check plus the WindowCases.ps1 rule at gate time.

key_decisions.decision:
There is one record file per proof source under docs/proof-runs:
- w001-<letter>-drive.json for drive-letter roots;
- w002-rig.json or w002-onedrive.json;
- w003-rig.json or w003-<network>-<link>.json.
UNC and folder roots keep artifacts/w001-run.json.

W-001 writes the finished part as soon as that run is judged, and rewrites the same file with the 'stopped' part in a finally. A letter run without -Stopped or -Force refuses, before scanning, to overwrite a file that holds a 'stopped' part.

Coverage is required on local letters only, and is recorded without being required on network letters.
key_decisions.rationale: Finish lines 1-3 need exactly one new or changed record per command. Writing early keeps an hour-long C:\ run if the stopped run fails. Letter-only names keep separators out of file names. Q-003 (is there a panel on Z:\ itself) is open, so W-001 must not fail on its unknown answer.

Renaming the old entry would leave two rules with the same patterns, one of them over a dead path. The constraint removes the plant rows that point at .taad/slices. The replacements point at docs/proof-runs, and without them nothing would prove the moved guard fires under Fitness's Python reading (lesson #75). The proposal named that gap as its own risk.

key_decisions.decision:
E003-1 as planted cannot pass on uat, and the design does not try to make that one line pass. Its line `-not (Test-Path .taad\slices)` fails whatever is built, because the engine commits its own slice records. Following Q-010, the acceptance for that half is:
- `git grep -n -i taad -- tests/window/WindowCases.ps1` prints nothing;
- after a run, `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- .taad` shows nothing beyond the engine's own SL-003 records and fitness.yaml.
Every other check in E003-1 is met as written.
key_decisions.rationale: Q-010 is answered: the check is rewritten. That answer is newer than the finish line's text and nothing measured contradicts it. Deleting the engine's records would not hold, because the next merge commits them again. Q-010 was decided by a model, not a person, and the reviewer should know that.

key_decisions.decision: Retire O-030-ledger-discharge, SL-062-LedgerCases, SL-068-DecisionCases, SL-107-HarnessPlantsOverRecord.Tests.py and SL-107-HandOffCases.ps1. Rewrite only SL-107-RecordPathRule.Tests.ps1 and its corpus's rule name. No RuleCases case is retired.
key_decisions.rationale: The constraint retires the scripts that read .taad/slices. The corpus runner is the kept guard's own test. A grep of tests/rules finds no S83-S86, P36 or SL-089 reference, so none of C-006 to C-014 depends on the removed rows.

key_decisions.decision:
Raise W-001's wait from 1200 s to 3600 s for both runs.
-Stopped uses the existing stop mode with FSA_HOOK_AT_FOLDERS at half the finished folder count, plus FSA_HOOK_ROWS=1, and the hook is not changed.
A run is partial only when it is Cancelled with sized '-'. Otherwise the case retries with n halved, up to 3 times, then ends inconclusive.
key_decisions.rationale: Spike c-drive-elapsed-within-w001-timeout was no-go: earlier C:\ walks reached 1,299 s, and a timeout writes no report. Spike hook-stop-atfolders-with-rows-dump was go on 3 of 3 runs. A trigger met during the sizing pass cuts no folder short, so it proves nothing about C5.

Spike denied-set-gains-no-folders-in-30-min held on 549 of 549 folders, but never looked under C:\Users\sshub, OneDrive or the CrossDevice root. Spike sync-roots-match-scanner-env found that root unknown to the scanner, and provider errors there can come and go between runs. An unproven input may cost a rerun, but never produces a false FAILED.

key_decisions.decision: C4 is evidenced by the 'refused-another-code' oracle class. Its count has its own Check and is added to the leak argument of an unchanged Get-W001Verdict. A reason/code consistency count sits beside it as a weaker second check.
key_decisions.rationale: HeldFolderReasonTests shows that a denial answers 5 ahead of a sharing violation. A code-5 row that now probes with another code therefore means the plain open got through, which is the shape where the product must have kept the plain open's code. Keeping the signature means the existing Theory and every caller need no change.

The corpus runner checks that the writer and the rule agree on every row, so the writer cannot be loosened. The 995 reason ('The I/O operation ...') holds a slash, and it is exactly the regression -Stopped and W-003 record. A walk that drops strings cannot leak panel text such as remainder.text, and needs no field list to keep in step with the report.

key_decisions.decision: Online-only means FILE_ATTRIBUTE_RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS. It is read by a Seam method that only lists, never opens a file, and descends only into plain and cloud-tagged directories. hydrated counts files that were online-only before, are present after, and are no longer online-only.
key_decisions.rationale: It is the project's own marker (CloudPlaceholderTests), and a reader that only lists cannot cause the hydration it checks for. A file that is gone is kept apart from one that was hydrated.

key_decisions.decision: W-003 times Stop to the ending from the acted line's ms to the 'rows read' ms, on the one hook clock. In rig mode it judges the cut folder by N-005's rule: s, any 995 row, and t or u when first opened after the Stop. In real mode the existing armed marker is written when the person types 'cut', within the hook's fixed 60 s MarkerDeadline. W-001, W-002 and W-003 never run under -Case All.
key_decisions.rationale: The spike confirmed that both ms values come from StartupHook.Clock. N-005's code shows t and u may be listed before the Stop, so a fixed count of 2 rows would fail a correct run. A hook change to lengthen the marker deadline is ruled out. Wi-Fi off and Tailscale down are instant, and the maintainer can have the server's sleep ready before starting.

payload.coherence_check:
There was one proposal, so there is no composition to check across designers. Nothing here has yet survived a disagreement, and the reviewer should treat this as the first time anyone argues with it.

I checked the proposal's pieces against the tree and against each other.

(1) Fitness entries. The engine had already appended three '# settled by SL-003' entries (.taad/fitness.yaml:1495-1524; git status shows fitness.yaml modified). They are:
- a docs/proof-runs/*.json record rule with SL-107's three patterns;
- a plants.json rule;
- a WindowCases.ps1 rule with the proposal's own '\.taad[\\/]+slices' pattern.
The proposal would have renamed the SL-107 entry as well, giving two rules with the same patterns. Redesigned: those three entries are this design's architecture_rules, word for word. The builder deletes the SL-107 entry and adds no fitness entry. awaiting_file is keyed by the appended rule's name.

(2) Plant rows. The proposal removed S83-S86 and P36 and listed the result as its own risk: no plant would prove the moved guard fires under Fitness's reading. Changed: the same five texts are planted at docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json under new ids. harness.py's Planting already plants over an awaited file. The constraint is read as 'rows pointing at .taad/slices go'.

(3) Strict writer against the finally. The writer throws by design, and the stopped part is written in a finally. A throw there would hide the run's real ending. The seam is made consistent by having callers pass the writer only what it accepts (Get-RecordByCode, Get-CountsOnly, labels pinned by a Fact). A throw is then a writer bug that fails loudly, never a run outcome.

(4) Two notions of a partial run. W-001 -Stopped uses the progress trigger; its acted line carries atfolders, folders and sized. W-003 uses the armed marker; its acted line carries enabled, visible, ms and sincearmed. Read-ActedLine reads ms with ' ms=(\d+) (?:utc|sincearmed)=', so both forms parse, and the leading space keeps 'atfolders=' from being read as the count.

(5) W-003's rig row count. The proposal expected exactly 2 rows. N-005 (WindowCases.ps1:5798-5800) shows t and u are judged by when they were first opened relative to the Stop. Changed to that rule.

(6) Error contract. Every case uses the harness's existing endings: NOT RUN exit 2, INCONCLUSIVE exit 3, FAILED exit 1. Every record goes through one writer under one fitness rule.

(7) E003-1 against Q-010. The planted E003-1 holds a line, `-not (Test-Path .taad\slices)`, that fails on uat whatever is built. Q-010 (answered, by a model) rewrites that half as a git check, so the design meets every other line and records that the planted test exits 1 on that line alone. That is not a defect in the slice.

(8) No outside-defect workaround. No product code changes and no outside defect is stepped around, so no new setting or notice is needed. The existing wcifs-layer-store precaution is only checked to be on.

(9) Staleness. Changing tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 makes the person's network pass stale (docs/design/SL-020-scanner.md:239-249); their W-003 share runs are that re-check. The C:\ and OneDrive lists cover src/**, which this slice does not touch.

(10) Where the evidence comes from. Window cases give no signal without an interactive desktop (lesson #261). Build and code review report E003-1 to E003-5 as not run, and validate runs them. Fitness op=check and the rules harness must run before review (lessons #279, #486).

(11) Known residue for the maintainer's C:\ run. The CrossDevice sync root is unknown to Scanner.SyncRootsFromEnvironment (spike no-go). Under the M1 classes it can make -Stopped INCONCLUSIVE, never FAILED. Changing the scanner belongs to another epic, not this design.

architecture_rules.name: a committed proof-run record carries counts, codes and reasons, never a path
architecture_rules.because: These files are committed records of scans of the maintainer's own C:\, OneDrive and shares. A path in one, or a dumped row with a 'path' key, publishes their folder names (Q-016). Write-W001Record refuses a slash or a backslash only at write time, so without this rule a hand edit before the commit, or a later writer, would pass every gate. The patterns are SL-107's, unchanged: a valid record's only backslashes are the JSON escapes for a quote and for a code unit that is not a separator.

architecture_rules.name: the rules harness plants nothing into, and waits on nothing under, .taad/slices
architecture_rules.because: .taad/slices holds the engine's own slice records, which it prunes and rewrites at merges (21632dc removed 771 files there). A plant row there collides with an engine record. An awaited file there waits on a record no proof run writes any more, so the clean baseline would accept the guard as unmatched for ever (SC-005).

architecture_rules.name: the window harness neither reads nor writes TAAD's slice records
architecture_rules.because: W-001 wrote its whole-C:\ record into .taad/slices/SL-089, which the engine owns and pruned, so the record owed since SL-107 was never kept. Window cases give no signal without an interactive desktop (lesson #261), so only a text rule catches a case pointed back there at gate time.

cases.behaviour: W-001 writes its whole-drive record where it is kept
cases.shape: the root is a whole SUBST drive letter over a %TEMP% tree with one folder this account may not list
cases.why: The record path was a branch on 'whole drive and starts with C:'. A letter other than C:, or a path left behind under .taad or artifacts, is exactly the SC-005 defect. The retired scripts must also be gone.
cases.check: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/E003-1-W001RecordUnderProofRuns.Tests.ps1 must print 'ok' on every line except 'nothing was written under .taad/slices', which Q-010 replaces. For that half: git grep -n -i taad -- tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 prints nothing, and git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- .taad lists nothing beyond .taad/fitness.yaml and .taad/slices/SL-003/

cases.behaviour: W-001 requires and records the coverage panel's figures on a whole drive
cases.shape: a local whole-drive root whose ending shows the coverage panel
cases.why: W-001 never read outcome or coverage ('coverage' appears 0 times in WindowCases.ps1). A finished run with no panel would pass, and C1a stays partial.

cases.behaviour: W-001 -Stopped compares a run stopped partway with the finished run
cases.shape: two refused folders that sort first, then 30,000 empty folders, so the Stop lands mid-walk
cases.why: No case ever stopped a run and compared its tab with a finished run's. C5 needs a stopped run that is really partial, and a comparison that is written down.

cases.behaviour: classify a stopped run's row against the finished tab
cases.shape: each of the six classes: a 995 row; a code-5 row absent from the finished tab; one absent but created after the finished run began; a non-5 row absent; a non-5 row whose code differs; a code-5 row whose kind changed
cases.why: Without M1's split, an hour-long real C:\ pair with provider churn reads as FAILED. Without the 995 and notInFinished branches, a folder Stop cut short passes.

cases.behaviour: decide whether a stopped run was partial, from the hook's acted line
cases.shape: the progress form, whose 'atfolders=' comes before 'folders=', with sized '-' or a number, or a run that ended Completed; and the armed form, whose ms is followed by sincearmed=
cases.why: A loose 'folders=(\d+)' reads the trigger value. A trigger met in the sizing pass cuts no folder short, so it would be taken for proof of C5.

cases.behaviour: show that a row's code is the code of the call that failed (C4)
cases.shape: a code-5 NothingListed row whose folder now answers the plain open with 32, because it is held without read sharing
cases.why: Get-OracleRow classes any non-zero probe as 'refused' without comparing codes, so a code taken from the keep-last-access open instead of the plain open passes today.

cases.behaviour: check that each row's reason belongs to its code
cases.shape: a row whose reason ends '(Windows error N)' with N not its own code, and two rows with one code but different reasons
cases.why: CheckPanelAgrees checks only that reasons are not blank, and byCode keeps the first row's reason, so a mismatched reason is never seen.

cases.behaviour: write a record after an expensive run
cases.shape: a row with code 995, whose reason 'The I/O operation ...' holds a slash; and a coverage object holding remainder.text
cases.why: Write-W001Record throws on any string with a separator, or one that is not a reason, so the very regression -Stopped records, or the panel's own text, would lose an hour-long run's record.

cases.behaviour: label a record, and keep proof cases out of All
cases.shape: every -Network and -Link value, every fixed label, and -Case All with -IncludeCloud and -IncludeNetwork
cases.why: A label missing from the allowed set makes the writer throw at the end of a real run. A proof case under All would write under docs/proof-runs, or register a sync root, unasked.

cases.shape: 'C:\\', 'C:', a network letter such as Z:\\, a UNC share root, and a folder
cases.why: GetPathRoot calls a UNC root a whole drive. Requiring coverage on a network letter would build on the open Q-003, and the record path depends on the shape.

cases.behaviour: prove a scan hydrates no online-only file
cases.shape: the CfProvider 'tree' rig root, whose files are online-only before the scan
cases.why: No case compares online-only state before and after a scan. The real OneDrive run is the maintainer's, so the loop's proof of the case is the rig.

cases.shape: a file still online-only; one hydrated; one gone since the first listing; and a root with no online-only file at all
cases.why: A gone file read as hydrated fails falsely, and a root with nothing online-only would 'hold' while proving nothing.

cases.behaviour: time Stop to a usable window on a share that stopped answering, and keep the cut folder out
cases.shape: the stall rig holding s's listing, with t and u first opened before or after the Stop
cases.why: No Stop on a share has ever been timed, and a fixed count of 2 rows would fail a correct run in which t or u was listed before the Stop.

cases.behaviour: guard committed records against paths at their new place
cases.shape: a record holding a UNC path, a single-backslash path, a forward-slash path, a 'path' key, and a whole valid record, each planted at docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json
cases.why: docs/proof-runs/*.json matches no file until the maintainer commits one. Only plants show the moved rule fires under Fitness's reading, and only the awaiting_file entry lets the clean baseline pass.
cases.check: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/bugs/SL-107-RecordPathRule.Tests.ps1 and python -I eng/rules-harness/harness.py --scenario all (with the TAAD engine its header names)

Its allowed set is held, failed, inconclusive, whole-drive, folder, Completed, Cancelled, RootUnreadable and Refused. It throws, writing nothing, on any other string that is not a 40-hex commit or a given reason free of slashes and backslashes.
A code-5 NothingListed row whose probe error is not 0, 2 or 3 is classed 'refused', without comparing that error with the row's code.
Takes the controls, a leak count and a failure count. It returns 'failed' on any failure or leak, 'inconclusive' when a checker control misbehaved, and otherwise 'held'.
Plants control-denied and control-refused-keep in the case folder it is given, not in the scanned root.
Takes the report, the rows dump, a label and an optional expected count that defaults to -1.

Holds a folder through TestNative.HoldFolderSharingNoRead before denying it, and expects the scan to record the plain open's sharing violation.

cross_domain_transfer.source_domain: Metamorphic testing (compilers, scientific software) and SRE game days
cross_domain_transfer.pattern: Nothing can say in advance which folders a stopped C:\ scan should list as unreadable. So W-001 -Stopped checks a relation between two runs on the same input: a stopped walk adds no code-5 failures and no aborted rows that the finished walk lacks. Differences that a change in the input can explain are tallied or left undecided, never failed. The share case is a game day: a person injects the fault, the clock runs inside the process, and a sanitised after-action record is committed.
cross_domain_transfer.rationale: The relation needs no new reference answer and catches exactly C5's defect: a folder Stop cut short shows up as a 995 row, or as a code-5 row the finished tab lacks. Separating input changes is what metamorphic testing does when the system under test reads a live environment.

invariants.precondition: Apart from what Stop does, the set of folders refused with code 5 does not change between the finished and the stopped run.
invariants.evidence: Spike denied-set-gains-no-folders-in-30-min: 549/549, 0 newly denied, but it left out C:\Users\sshub, OneDrive, the layer store and CrossDevice. The relation is enforced only for code-5 rows that existed before the finished run; non-5 differences are INCONCLUSIVE.

invariants.precondition: A row's identity is stable across the two runs.
invariants.evidence: Same -Root, and RowsMode dumps the path. Spike: every stopped row was in R0 with the same kind and code, 3/3.

invariants.precondition: The second run is really partial.
invariants.evidence: Spike: Cancelled with sized '-' at 15,202-18,302 of 30,302 folders, and z-deny-z was missing from every stopped run. W-001 checks this on every run and retries.

invariants.precondition: A wrongly recorded cut folder leaves a mark the relation can see.
invariants.evidence: Settle turns any call made after the cancel into 995, and FolderDone drops a 995 when a cancel was requested (survey: SynchronousIoCancel.cs:422, Scanner.cs:384-385). A regression shows as an aborted or notInFinished row.

invariants.precondition: The game day's fault is injected by the person, never by the loop.
invariants.evidence: W-003 real mode writes the marker only after the person types 'cut'. The loop's rig mode stalls a TAAD-made loopback server.

channeled_experts: T. Y. Chen (metamorphic testing: a relation between two runs in place of an oracle)
John Allspaw (game days: a human-injected fault, an in-process clock, a written after-action record)

prior_art.pattern: A committed verification record lists each claim with PASS or FAIL, the environment it ran in, and counts compared before and after.
A share scan marks counts cut short by a limit as 'Limited', a lower bound, apart from finished 'OK' counts. A stopped tab is treated as a subset of the finished one.
One execution per source, each with its own status, object count and duration: one record per proof source.
Real-OneDrive end-to-end tests run on dedicated test accounts. Here the only account is the maintainer's, so the loop proves the case on a local cloud-files rig.
Metamorphic testing: where no oracle exists, check a relation between related runs, and separate input-change violations from violations of the relation.
prior_art.where: Chen, Cheung and Yiu, metamorphic testing literature

prior_art.pattern: Approval-test scrubbers strip machine-specific values such as paths before a record is committed.
The Cloud Files API marks a placeholder whose data is not local with FILE_ATTRIBUTE_RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS, and enumerating a directory reads attributes without fetching data.
Game days: a human-injected fault, an in-process clock and an after-action record.

taste_disagreements: The verdict: the proposal gave Get-W001Verdict a refusedAnotherCode parameter. This design adds that count to the leak argument and gives it its own Check, as leaks already have, so the signature does not change. Either works.

The plant rows: the proposal removed S83-S86 and P36 without replacement. This design re-plants the same five texts at docs/proof-runs under new ids. A reviewer reading the constraint's 'only the plant rows that point at .taad/slices are removed' more strictly may disagree.
Copying coverage: by a named field list (the proposal) or by a walk that drops strings (this design).
Compare-StoppedRows keeps six classes. Merging codeChanged into notInFinished would be simpler, at the cost of the console naming which happened.
The -Force guard against overwriting a stopped part is a small convenience that could be dropped, since git shows the change anyway.

retier.why: The design changes .taad/fitness.yaml and eng/rules-harness/plants.json, which the engine's Fitness and the rules harness read at every gate of every slice. It deletes a settled SL-107 rule and five of its plant rows. Its replacement covers a glob, docs/proof-runs/*.json, that matches no file until the maintainer commits a record, and only the re-planted rows show it fires under Fitness's own reading. It also defines the committed record format that the person's proof runs and the release rest on. A wrong glob or a mis-keyed awaiting_file would silently remove the privacy guard, with every gate still green.

payload.reason: Attempt 2, rewritten with the spike's answer to fork O-002. Stop mode with FSA_HOOK_AT_FOLDERS plus FSA_HOOK_ROWS=1 held on 3 of 3 runs, so the design keeps its shape with no hook change. The composition also fixes three seams against the tree: it adopts the fitness entries the engine had already appended, re-plants the moved guard's rows, and makes W-003's rig judgement follow N-005's rule for t and u.
